name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.67.0: Draw the node detail's groups as cards; Keep the traced route out of the node detail's action block; Keep a card heading in the list's own leading gutter; Give a list control the row's resting ground, not its current one.
changelog.v2.66.0: Measure the edit buffer from the field table.
changelog.v2.65.0: Bring the node detail up to the component set; Open the detail on a real row from the map, and key its switches by node.
changelog.v2.64.0: Install the radio's firmware from Settings; Revalidate the radio, refuse TCP, and let the loader be recovered from.
changelog.v2.63.1: Bound a direction's reach to one step so the map can be explored.
